title: Canonical identification of a supported triangle by its first arrow
statement:
Fix a finite commutative ring $A$. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact $i_*$ and $i^*,j^*$ as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $i^!_0M=i^*\ker(M\to j_*j^*M)$ [def-pur-flasque-support], and write $S=Ri^!_0$ on $D^+$, with its support counit $\epsilon:i_*SK\to K$ as in [lem-pur-support-localization-triangle]. Let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $L\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. Suppose given a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]
$$i_*L\xrightarrow{a}K\xrightarrow{\eta_j}Rj_*j^*K\xrightarrow{b}(i_*L)[1],$$
whose second arrow is the open adjunction unit. Let
$$\theta:L\longrightarrow SK,\qquad \epsilon_K\circ i_*\theta=a,$$
be the unique transpose of $a$ under $i_*\dashv S$. Then $\theta$ is an isomorphism, and $(i_*\theta,\operatorname{id}_K,\operatorname{id}_{Rj_*j^*K})$ is an isomorphism from the given triangle to the support-localization triangle of [lem-pur-support-localization-triangle], including its third arrow. This isomorphism is independent of any completion of a morphism of triangles. For families of such triangles in which $a$ is natural, $\theta$ is natural. No etale-origin or constructibility hypothesis on $K,L$ is imposed.
